purpose: Capture planning only. This is not a capture manifest or a review result.

captureDefaults.grounding: Positions without y use rendered terrain. Wait until world.pending is false after moving a fixture, then place it again so streamed terrain and grounding agree. initialGroundY values below refer to the origin-centered terrain rings and must not substitute for the final streamed surface.
captureDefaults.camera: Third-person setPose distances clamp to3–9m and pitch to−0.15–1.1rad. Yaw0 views the avatar from behind looking toward−Z; yawπ gives the front. Always record actual camera position, distance and occlusion from diagnostics.
captureDefaults.evidence: Keep full uncropped frames, actual trusted input track, timestamps and gap report. Store complete frame sequences and normal-speed playback. Capture before input, transitions, release and recovery. Include the HUD. Fixed-clock runs establish action order and contacts; real-time runs establish input response.

commandTemplates.reducedMotion: Add --still to the corresponding still or sequence command.
commandTemplates.materialize: Each sequences[].sequence object is directly consumable by --sequence. For fixed-clock counterparts add fixedStepMs:16.666666666666668; leave it absent for real-time. Expand profile IDs by merging their complete appearance into sequence.fixture.appearance. Camera angle variants change fixture.camera only. Do not invoke hooks to perform tested movement or declare an action complete. For sequence cameraVariants, merge camera into fixture.camera and remap event.code through eventCodeMap before writing that concrete sequence file.
commandTemplates.performanceBaseline: The coordinator owns comparison against the required baseline. Record when the chosen baseline lacks checks/wilds.html instead of claiming a populated-world comparison.

neutralHandoff: The independent reviewer receives the rubric and actual captures with neutral metadata. Do not send this planning document, source code, implementation explanations or hypotheses.

appearanceCoverage.rule: The six complete profiles cover every existing value of skin, hair, top, bottom, style, outfit, bottomStyle and accessory. This is coverage of every option, not a claim to capture every Cartesian combination.

stillMatrix.framing: Keep the entire body and shoes in each view; add a supplementary face or garment detail crop only after the uncropped close view exists.

motionMatrix.notes: These four profiles include every hair, outfit, bottomStyle and accessory silhouette. Profiles05 and06 add palette extremes in the still matrix. Add their sequences in any theme where the stills show contrast or material separation requiring motion evidence.

sequences.notes: Six seconds idle plus1300ms walk and1000ms sprint show at least two loops each. Normal jump includes short fall and landing transitions, not two full fall loops. Reuse audited input schedule, recapture current post-gate build. The side-tracking variant replaces W with D while keeping camera yaw0, so movement crosses the view and exposes planted feet.
All turns and camera movement come from actual key/pointer events. Camera dragging also emits the currently mapped left-button action; no combat result is asserted in M1.
Existing lh flow checks a31s forward route reaches z<−145. Capture the entire route, not just its endpoint. Refine with actual directional input if the current path/collider layout prevents it.
Normal-speed walking from forest edge through the gate toward z≈−127. This complements the full route at a view where feet and terrain remain readable.
Start with100stamina, hold sprint beyond100/14seconds, release long enough to show recovery, then sprint again. This is a response/feedback capture, not an authored-cycle-only clip.
Existing lh flow reaches climb after300ms at this fixture. The low rock cannot provide two700ms climb loops; use the tall outcrop capture for full clip coverage.

The5.5m outcrop supports about2.75seconds of ascent at2m/s, enough for two700ms loops plus entry and exit. At x−9,z−38.98, forward input reaches the collider contact shell. Stop if captured setup does not reach this face; record the actual corrected fixture.
sequences.cameraRequirement: Both variants move toward the same outcrop face at world−Z. The side camera uses D with yawπ/2. Check that ordinary camera collision does not hide the contacts and retain any obstruction in the evidence.

sequences.notes: Start on the reachable outcrop top, whose y is the rendered base plus5.5m. This setup is allowed but does not itself show the ascent; pair it with climb-outcrop. Natural descent is shorter than two fall loops. Confirm support against the runtime collider before recording.

Explicit elevated starting-position fixture for authored asset coverage. It starts29m above the clearing and falls under ordinary physics, staying within the30m recovery threshold. It does not prove an accessible cliff, a player-initiated jump, or control response. Pair with actual Space and outcrop sequences. Confirm two800ms cycles and the full landing after capture.

Begin south of the outcrop with a clear camera ray. With camera yawπ, S moves the player toward the outcrop and brings the camera into collision. Capture contraction, release, then a pointer turn and movement away. This fixture is a candidate until actual framing and contact are inspected.

captureExecutionNotes: Run the milestone gates before capturing the review build. Preserve earlier rounds without overwriting.

Take current M1 wide stills first, then close details and appearance matrix; capture sequences after correcting any obstructed or invalid fixture. Record changes to candidate coordinates in the neutral manifest.

For every distant feature attempt current ground approach and nearest accessible detail as well as the first-vista silhouette. A distant:true source flag does not exempt visible unfinished geometry from review.

When an inaccessible sky surface or ordinary camera limit prevents the required detail, record the missing observation explicitly. A separately labelled inspection camera may supplement geometry evidence but cannot stand in for normal gameplay access.
For fixed captures, distinguish scheduled input offset, actual trusted-event game time, rendered frame game time and screenshot-completion wall time. Use the real-time runs for response timing.

Keep terrain, feet, and target/obstacle visible during contact sequences. Increase field of view only through an explicitly recorded supplementary capture, not by silently changing the gameplay camera.
The full-frame real-time output must retain every captured frame and its timestamp. Confirm decoded frame count/order against sequence.json and report every capture gap.
Performance, hidden-tab suspension, lifecycle, save isolation and Blender provenance remain separate technical gates; screenshots cannot establish them.
